Stripe — Full-Stack Software Engineer (Billing & Subscriptions)

About the Role:
Stripe powers online commerce for millions of businesses worldwide. In this role on the Billing platform, you will design, build, and operate resilient web applications and high-throughput backend APIs that process billions of dollars in recurring revenue.

Responsibilities:
- Build delightful, accessible, and high-performance customer-facing dashboards and checkout surfaces using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS.
- Design and maintain reliable distributed backend services in Node.js/TypeScript and Ruby, backed by PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis.
- Architect idempotent billing engines and subscription state machines capable of handling complex proration, usage metering, and multi-currency invoicing.
- Partner cross-functionally with Product Managers, Designers, and Risk teams to ship robust financial workflows.
- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct thorough design reviews, and establish operational excellence on-call.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience across both frontend and backend systems.
- Strong proficiency in modern TypeScript, React, and server-side runtimes (Node.js or similar).
- Deep understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL), transactional consistency, schema migrations, and indexing strategies.
- Experience designing clean RESTful or GraphQL APIs with an emphasis on developer ergonomics, idempotency, and backward compatibility.
- Experience with automated testing (unit, integration, e2e) and CI/CD pipelines.

Nice to Have:
- Prior background in fintech, payments, billing systems, or fraud mitigation.
- Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, or AWS cloud infrastructure.

Vercel — Senior Frontend Infrastructure Engineer

About Vercel:
Vercel is the creator of Next.js and the platform for frontend developers, enabling teams to build and deploy web applications instantly.

What You'll Do:
- Architect and maintain core frontend design systems, dashboard foundations, and runtime preview tooling for millions of developers.
- Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and runtime client performance across large-scale single-page and server-rendered applications.
- Build rich interactive workflows, real-time collaboration features (WebSocket/Server-Sent Events), and deployment visualization graphs in React 19 and Next.js App Router.
- Drive accessibility (a11y - WCAG 2.1 AA) and keyboard-first navigation patterns across all UI surfaces.
- Write developer documentation, maintain comprehensive test suites (Vitest, Playwright), and contribute to open-source tooling.

Qualifications:
- 5+ years building production web applications with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS/Tailwind.
- Mastery of modern browser APIs, DOM lifecycle, rendering pipelines, and bundlers (Turbopack, Vite, Webpack).
- In-depth understanding of React Server Components (RSC), SSR, streaming, and edge computing paradigms.
- Passion for developer experience, component API design, and micro-interactions.

Bonus Points:
- Experience contributing to Next.js, React, or widely used open-source libraries.
- Familiarity with WebAssembly, Canvas/WebGL visualizations, or edge KV stores.

Datadog — Senior Backend Engineer (Metrics Ingestion & Storage)

Position Overview:
Datadog is the monitoring and security platform for cloud applications. Our data plane ingests tens of trillions of events and metrics every day. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to scale our time-series ingestion and query pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, scale, and operate mission-critical backend microservices handling millions of writes per second with sub-second p99 query latency.
- Implement distributed consensus, partitioning, and replication algorithms for custom time-series data stores.
- Optimize service resource utilization (memory footprint, garbage collection pauses, CPU cache efficiency) in Go, Python, or C++.
- Troubleshoot complex distributed race conditions, network partitions, and node failover scenarios in Kubernetes environments.
- Participate in an on-call rotation with high engineering autonomy to resolve root causes.

Minimum Qualifications:
- 5+ years of systems engineering experience developing scalable, high-availability distributed services.
- Strong systems programming skills in Go, Rust, Java, or Python.
- Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: CAP theorem, Paxos/Raft consensus, gossip protocols, and vector clocks.
- Hands-on experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar high-throughput distributed commit logs.
- Strong Linux networking, profiling (pprof, perf), and debugging capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience building custom database engines or time-series indexing (LSM-trees, B-trees).
- Experience with Kubernetes, eBPF, or Terraform in AWS/GCP.

Perplexity AI — Software Engineer (LLM Applications & Search RAG)

About Perplexity:
Perplexity is an AI-first conversational answer engine that delivers accurate, grounded information with inline citations.

What You Will Build:
- Design and deploy low-latency Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines combining vector search, BM25 keyword search, and neural re-ranking.
- Develop LLM agentic workflows, multi-step query decomposition, and factual verification systems to minimize hallucinations.
- Build high-throughput async API endpoints using Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous streaming (SSE) to deliver token-by-token answers.
- Implement prompt evaluation harnesses, automated synthetic benchmarks, and LLM-as-a-judge scoring frameworks to iterate on answer quality.
- Scale vector embeddings storage (Milvus, Qdrant, or pgvector) and Redis caching layers.

Requirements:
- 3+ years experience in software engineering with a strong track record building production AI/ML applications.
- Proficiency in Python and modern async programming (asyncio, FastAPI).
- Hands-on experience with frontier LLM APIs (Gemini, Claude, GPT-4) and vector embeddings.
- Solid understanding of information retrieval (IR), embeddings similarity search, tokenization, and context window management.
- High standards for code quality, testing, and latency optimization.

Nice to Have:
- Experience training or fine-tuning models (PyTorch, Hugging Face, LoRA).
- Background in web scraping, crawling pipelines, or search engine indexing.
